data.name: Don Memo
data.detailed_description:
Don Memo is an old bull who lives with his wife and granddaughter, Milagro. He descends from a proud lineage of brave bulls marked by the legend of Malacrianza, the mythical bull who was the first to face the demon Pisuicas and managed to banish him to hell. Since then, Malacrianza’s descendants have inherited the responsibility of fighting Pisuicas, who returns whenever negativity in the world rises.

Don Memo also fought his battle in the past, successfully banishing Pisuicas. However, the demon quickly returned due to the growing hatred and despair in humanity. Years later, Don Memo’s son carried on the legacy and, alongside his wife, gave his life to banish Pisuicas once again. Since that tragedy, Don Memo has cared for his granddaughter Milagro.

Now, in the present, Pisuicas has returned sooner than expected—and this time, he has kidnapped Milagro. Burdened by the pain of his past and the weight of the years on his back, Don Memo sets out on one final journey across Costa Rica. He must face not only ancient legends and dangers, but also the weight of his legacy and the fear of failing once more.

  • Machete Mastery – Wield Don Memo’s trusty machete for fast, close-quarters combat. Slash, parry, and chain combos with precision timing to cut through hordes of Pisuicas’ minions.

  • Tools of the Land – Find and master extra weapons inspired by real Costa Rican tools like the trompo, the carpintero hammer, or the resortera for ranged crowd control.

  • Dynamic Platforming – Leap between swaying jungle bridges, wall-run along canyon cliffs, and slide down volcanic slopes. Use machete swings to cut vines and carve new paths mid-jump.

  • Folklore Boss Battles – Confront titanic foes pulled from Costa Rican legend: fire-eyed Cadejos, La Llorona, and spirits turned monstrous by Pisuicas’ corruption.

  • Story Rooted in Costa Rica – Traverse vibrant, pixel-art landscapes inspired by the country’s real geography: cloud forests, sugarcane fields, coastal fishing villages, while uncovering a tale of family, legacy, and myth.

data.short_description: Don Memo is a brave bull who embarks on one final journey across Costa Rica to rescue his granddaughter and confront Pisuicas. Fight against legends and shadows of the past in this 2D pixel platformer, while carrying the legacy of a family destined to protect the world from evil.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Whatever your computer has
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: The most "Tuanis" one they have
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Where it can be played Jugo e' Piña
  • Additional Notes: It is recommended to play while enjoying a coffee and bread with cheese.
